title: e2e drive reports success even when captures are never written (early window close or screenshot failure)
evidence:
app/main.odin:366 `for !rl.WindowShouldClose() {` ... 613-622:
			switch app.noc_e2e_frame {
			case NOC_E2E_CAPTURE_ON:
				rl.TakeScreenshot("bin/noc-e2e-on.png")
			case NOC_E2E_CAPTURE_OFF:
				rl.TakeScreenshot("bin/noc-e2e-off.png")
			}
			if app.noc_e2e_frame >= NOC_E2E_EXIT {
				break
tools/run-dev.sh:37-39:
  PP_NOC_E2E=1 ./bin/app-dev
  echo "run-dev: e2e done — bin/noc-e2e-on.png (panel) vs bin/noc-e2e-off.png (no panel)"
(vendor:raylib binding: `TakeScreenshot :: proc(fileName: cstring)` — no success return)
detail: If the window closes before frame 120/240, or TakeScreenshot fails (unwritable path), the app exits 0 and the script unconditionally prints success — the mechanical proof can vacuously pass with missing artifacts.
recommended_fix: After the e2e run, verify bin/noc-e2e-on.png and bin/noc-e2e-off.png exist and are non-empty; exit non-zero and print the missing files otherwise.

title: run-dev.sh silently drops documented runtime args (--stats-out never reaches the app)
evidence:
tools/run-dev.sh:14 `# tools/run-dev.sh --stats-out

# pass-through (the app's telemetry flag)` tools/run-dev.sh:30 `odin build app -define:PP_DEBUG=true -out:bin/app-dev "${ARGS[@]+}" 2>&1 | head -20` tools/run-dev.sh:41 ` ./bin/app-dev` (no ARGS) bash-verified: with ARGS=(--stats-out /tmp/x), "${ARGS[@]+}" expands to exactly ONE empty-string argument, not the array contents; odin build accepts the empty arg and exits 0
detail:
Documented `--stats-out

` is never passed anywhere: the build line receives only an empty-string arg, and the run line `./bin/app-dev` gets no arguments — telemetry is silently not collected.
recommended_fix: Use `odin build app -define:PP_DEBUG=true -out:bin/app-dev` and run `./bin/app-dev "${ARGS[@]}"` to forward runtime args to the binary.

title: PP_NOC_E2E=0 or =false still arms the auto-drive (any non-empty value arms)
detail: Conventional disarm values ("0", "false") are non-empty, so they arm the drive: the run auto-presses D and force-exits at frame 300 (NOC_E2E_EXIT), truncating what the user expected to be a normal dev session.
recommended_fix: Treat only explicit truthy values (e.g. "1", "true") as armed; ignore or warn on other non-empty values.

title: Edit rejections that occur while the overlay is OFF are never counted
detail: The latch only observes transitions while overlay_on; input.last_reject retains just the newest rejection. Toggling D on after a play session shows complete drop counters (mark catch-up) but an undercounted rejection total, silently.
recommended_fix: Sample the rejection latch every frame regardless of overlay_on (drop the overlay_on condition for the reject block), so transitions while hidden are still counted.

title: Queue-row selection and section label hardcode 70 and 6 instead of the data-driven canon values
evidence:
noc_overlay.odin:499 `if p.q[0] + p.q[1] + p.q[2] > 0 || p.util_pct >= 70 {`
noc_overlay.odin:643 `if p.q[0] + p.q[1] + p.q[2] == 0 && p.util_pct < 70 {`
noc_overlay.odin:634-636:
	cur = noc_section(v, cur, scroll, visible, "QUEUES VS E9 BOUND (6)")
	bound := u32(max(1, cat.balance.lane_queue_packets))
	amber_pct := cat.balance.warnings.pipe_amber_pct
detail: Row inclusion filters at literal util 70 while bar colors derive from cat.balance.warnings.pipe_amber_pct, and the header restates the E9 bound as literal 6. A balance.json change desynchronizes row selection from coloring and mislabels the bound.
recommended_fix: Use cat.balance.warnings.pipe_amber_pct for the row predicate and format the section label from cat.balance.lane_queue_packets.

title: One drop event with unknown reason AND class >= 64 increments drop_other twice
detail: The two independent fallback guards both fire for a single event, so drop_other (and total_drops feeding noc_feed_drop_ratio) overcounts the event count while the log shows one row.
recommended_fix: Count the class-fallback into a separate field or make the else-branch conditional on a known reason (increment drop_other once per event).
